tools.name: purchase_ci_runner_minutes
tools.description: Buys an additional block of CI runner minutes by charging the team's saved payment method, then returns the updated minutes balance and receipt from the billing service.

params.name: org_id
params.description: Organization ID in the billing system

params.name: minutes
params.description: Number of runner minutes to purchase

params.name: max_price_cents
params.description: Refuse the purchase if the total would exceed this amount in cents

tools.code:
import os
import stripe
import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]
BILLING_URL = os.environ.get("CI_BILLING_URL", "https://billing.ci.internal")
PRICE_PER_MINUTE_CENTS = 8


def _get_balance(org_id: str) -> dict:
    resp = requests.get(f"{BILLING_URL}/orgs/{org_id}/balance", timeout=15)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()


@tool
def purchase_ci_runner_minutes(org_id: str, minutes: int, max_price_cents: int) -> dict:
    if minutes <= 0:
        return {"error": "minutes must be positive"}
    total = minutes * PRICE_PER_MINUTE_CENTS
    if total > max_price_cents:
        return {"error": f"total {total} exceeds limit {max_price_cents}"}
    before = _get_balance(org_id)
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=total,
        currency="usd",
        customer=before["stripe_customer_id"],
        payment_method=before["default_payment_method"],
        off_session=True,
        confirm=True,
        description=f"{minutes} CI runner minutes for {org_id}",
        metadata={"org_id": org_id, "minutes": str(minutes)},
    )
    after = _get_balance(org_id)
    return {
        "payment_intent": intent.id,
        "status": intent.status,
        "charged_cents": total,
        "balance_before": before.get("minutes_remaining"),
        "balance_after": after.get("minutes_remaining"),
    }

tools.name: publish_release_manifest_to_registry
tools.description: Writes a release manifest JSON file into the local release directory for a build and uploads it to the external artifact registry. Also posts a notice to the team's release webhook.

params.name: artifacts
params.description: List of artifact file names included in the release

tools.code:
import json
import os
import tempfile
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path

import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("ci-release")

RELEASE_DIR = Path(os.environ.get("RELEASE_DIR", "/var/ci/releases"))
REGISTRY_URL = os.environ.get("REGISTRY_URL", "https://registry.example.com/api/manifests")
WEBHOOK_URL = os.environ.get("RELEASE_WEBHOOK_URL", "")


@contextmanager
def _atomic_write(path: Path):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=path.parent, suffix=".tmp")
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as fh:
            yield fh
        os.replace(tmp, path)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(tmp):
            os.unlink(tmp)


@mcp.tool()
def publish_release_manifest_to_registry(build_id: str, version: str, artifacts: list) -> dict:
    manifest = {
        "build_id": build_id,
        "version": version,
        "artifacts": artifacts,
    }
    path = RELEASE_DIR / build_id / f"manifest-{version}.json"
    with _atomic_write(path) as fh:
        json.dump(manifest, fh, indent=2)
    with open(path, "rb") as fh:
        resp = requests.put(
            f"{REGISTRY_URL}/{version}",
            data=fh,
            headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
            timeout=30,
        )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    if WEBHOOK_URL:
        requests.post(
            WEBHOOK_URL,
            json={"text": f"Release {version} published from build {build_id}"},
            timeout=10,
        ).raise_for_status()
    return {"manifest_path": str(path), "registry_status": resp.status_code}

tools.name: archive_build_logs_to_s3
tools.description: Moves a build's log file from the local log directory to an S3 bucket for long-term storage.

params.name: build_id
params.description: Build identifier whose log should be archived

tools.code:
import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

import boto3

s3 = boto3.client("s3")
LOG_DIR = Path(os.environ.get("CI_LOG_DIR", "/var/ci/logs"))


@dataclass
class ArchiveResult:
    build_id: str
    s3_uri: str
    size_bytes: int


def archive_build_logs_to_s3(build_id: str, bucket: str) -> ArchiveResult:
    path = LOG_DIR / f"{build_id}.log"
    size = path.stat().st_size
    key = f"build-logs/{build_id}.log"
    s3.upload_file(str(path), bucket, key)
    path.unlink()
    return ArchiveResult(build_id, f"s3://{bucket}/{key}", size)
